event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: Hearings No. 5, 6, 7 were heard together in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since all hearings arose from very closely connected incidents.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
The boats were represented by: CRO 211911(boys) - Lorenzo Bertolino Yellow boys; CRO 211911 (girls) - Rita Kljaović Gašpic Blue girls; CRO 211312 - Marta Tudor Blue girls
The Technical Committee was represented by Jean-Luc Michon.
Mario Novak, coach of CRO 211911, CRO 211911, CRO 211312, attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: CRO 211911(b), CRO 211911 (g) CRO 211312 had received the supplied bibs from the OA during registration.
CRO 211911(b), CRO 211911 (g) CRO 211312 sailed in races 3 and 4 wearing their club bib.
CRO 211911(b), CRO 211911 (g) CRO 211312 were aware of SI 2.5, which stated: "All competitors will receive a bib vest and it is mandatory to wear it".
conclusions: CRO 211911(b), CRO 211911 (g) CRO 211312 did not wear the bib provided by the Organising Authority when racing and broke SI 2.5.
Since the breach did not affect racing performance, the penalty should be applied to the race sailed nearest in time to that of the incident.
decision: Using the WS Discretionary Penalty Policy, a starting penalty of 5% was decided. There were no facts to justify decreasing the penalty. There were no facts to justify increasing the penalty. CRO 211911 (girls), CRO 211911 (boys) and CRO 211312 to be scored with a 5% Scoring penalty applied to race 4.
